title: ReservationExpired payload (event, topic inventory.events)
description: The order's hold outlived its TTL and the sweeper returned the stock (SPEC §7). The order is marked released, so a later ReserveInventory is rejected. Not a reply: a saga still in its forward steps compensates (RESERVATION_EXPIRED); a finished or compensating saga ignores it. sagaId is the nil UUID for holds created before reservations recorded their saga.
